inputs.images: outputs/line01r/night01r2/lc/cases (120 stored records; 56 coded images are the replay material; 64 uncoded / 45 deg images stay as R2 controls, their front end is not touched)
inputs.front_end: lc_pipeline.shared_front_end with the R2 snapshot parameters (scale 2.0046884346862006 px, class widths 4.1667 / 6.9444 px, P4_C3_cal thresholds); rebuilt once per coded image from the stored image and verified array-by-array against the stored R2 arrays
inputs.readout: lc_readout.read_segments with the R2 snapshot read-out parameters (step 0.25 px, bg outer 20 % / quantile 25 %, half 0.5, peak = local maximum within +-1.5 px, contamination rule); verified against the stored readout_fwhm / readout_reason

arms.ignore: R2 LC_ignore (inherited; re-finished only to verify bit equality)
arms.use_replay: R2 LC_use rule replayed (threshold 6.05 px, min_rows 5, margin 0.5 px); must equal the stored LC_use arrays bit-exactly
arms.M: A3 single-factor replay: identical to use_replay except margin = 0.5 x MAD of the segment rows (the rule written in the R2 protocol 2.2); not a selectable candidate
arms.R: per-image reliability check (two-peak rule below) + old threshold 6.05 px, which must lie strictly between the two accepted peaks; otherwise the whole image falls back to ignore
arms.A: same reliability check + per-image adaptive threshold = valley between the two accepted peaks; fallback identical to R

reliability_rule.chain_weight: every detection chain with >= 1 valid row has total weight 1, split equally over its valid rows
reliability_rule.pair_choice: all pairs of qualified peaks with separation >= min_sep_px and valley depth <= max_depth; largest smoothed height sum, tie -> larger separation, tie -> lower indices
reliability_rule.fallback: no valid row / empty histogram / fewer than two qualified peaks / no admissible pair -> image fallback (ignore for every segment)
reliability_rule.class_hypothesis: low peak = narrow (0.75 mm), high peak = wide (1.25 mm); runtime uses only the code dictionary (parity of the design line id)
reliability_rule.segment_readable: n_valid >= 5 and |median - threshold| >= 0.5 px (unchanged from R2 implementation)
reliability_rule.numbering: R2 use rule: per readable segment remove admissible candidates of the other parity; empty -> original row (fallback count); single geometric candidate never changed (conflict count); nothing propagates across segments
reliability_rule.no_truth_input: lc_r3_reliability has no truth parameter; the replay runs the runtime path once and the evaluation twice (true labels / shuffled labels) and asserts identical runtime output hashes

budgets.accounting: 56 images x 4 arms (use_replay, M, R, A); ignore and O layer inherited from the same front end

gates_and_decision.wrong_id_scope: all confirmable accepted AND newly accepted (vs ignore), per image and per condition; unconfirmable share reported; new == 0 -> N/A
gates_and_decision.retention_requirement: dense fixed-peak main set (s 4.45, 0 deg, fixed peak, sigma 0/20/40, 2 surfaces, 2 phases = 12 images): amplitude |dA| <= 10 % in 12/12 AND positive dCtau vs ignore in every image
gates_and_decision.equal_integral_report: 8 dense equal-integral images (sigma 0/20/40 incl. the 4 at sigma 0): safe positive gain or fallback; abstention and coverage cost reported
gates_and_decision.control_63: s 6.3 mm images must not be changed by the protection (use == ignore there already)
selection_order: technical correctness (front end verified, use_replay bit-exact, no-truth check)
wrong-id gate per image and per condition on all accepted and newly accepted
retention requirement on the 12 dense fixed-peak images
equal-integral: safe gain or fallback (limited scope allowed)
if R and A both pass: min per-image dCtau on the dense fixed-peak set, then mean dCtau; identical -> R (simpler)
if protection only works by giving up (nearly) all gain or amplitude passes, or both fail: stop, no third candidate, no gate relaxation
gates_and_decision.meaning_of_pass: development candidate admissible for a later unseen validation; not an independent validation; no population error bound

evaluation_targets.ctau: r3 dent domain, d 6 mm, tau 0.15
evaluation_targets.tails: p95 / p99 / max of |dz| overall, ROI (r <= 15 mm) and newly accepted subset
